physicalNotes: Radius: Altair is a rapid rotator: Monnier et al. (2007), Science 317, 342, measure an equatorial radius of 2.029 ± 0.007 and a polar radius of 1.634 ± 0.011 solar radii with CHARA/MIRC. The record's radius is the volume-equivalent sphere of those two, 1.89 solar radii; the scene draws the measured flattening, with the equatorial radius on the outline. Adopted 1,313,290 km, 1.8877 solar radii at 695700 km per solar radius. No gravitational parameter is adopted. presentationUp: the display axis, the measured rotation pole, is up.
